name: Mysteries
overview: Scripture reveals that certain divine truths are hidden by God, reserved as secret things known only to Him, while what He has revealed is entrusted to His people so they may live according to His law. The Lord discloses His secrets to those who fear Him and to the righteous, often revealing them through His servants, the prophets. Jesus affirms that these mysteries are hidden from the wise and prudent but made known to the humble and childlike, highlighting God's sovereign choice in revealing His redemptive plan to those who receive Him with faith.
